low_power_modes_summary.stop_SCK: Controller stops driving SCK to halt streaming; bus idles in implementation-defined state.
low_power_modes_summary.mute: Not part of the 3-wire I2S protocol — implemented per-codec at register level.

fields.notes: I2S spec does not define formal sleep / suspend modes. Power management is deferred to the SoC + codec IP. Audio codecs typically support 'mute' and 'standby' via control registers (I2C or SPI bus, separate from the I2S audio bus).
